evals.prompt: Please update PR #123 checklist checkboxes based on the latest commits and CI results.
evals.expected_output: Agent gates to GitHub-only, fetches PR #123 body + checklist region, updates marker-bounded checkbox lines using evidence heuristics (required checks/tests/docs/linking/code changes), preserves any already-[x] items, and writes the updated PR body back via gh pr edit. It reports which boxes were checked and why.

evals.prompt: Sync the checklist for this PR description (PR #77) so none of the boxes are left unchecked when work is done.
evals.expected_output: Agent finds/creates the marker-bounded checklist region, applies never-uncheck, checks eligible items from evidence, avoids guessing when evidence is ambiguous, and confirms the resulting PR body checklist state.

evals.prompt: Update the Jira issue checklist for ticket ABC-12 based on Jira progress.
evals.expected_output: Agent does not activate in Jira-only context; it treats this as a near-miss and asks for the GitHub PR/URL to update (does not modify Jira or other systems).
